subject: chemistry

concepts.title: System Classification
concepts.definition: Thermodynamic systems are categorized by their ability to exchange matter and energy with the surroundings.
concepts.key_idea: Distinction based on boundary permeability to matter and energy.
question_patterns: define an open system
how does a closed system differ from an isolated one
give an example of an isolated system
classify a thermos flask as a type of system
explain the boundary of an open system

concepts.title: Pressure-Volume Work
concepts.definition: Mechanical work performed by or on a system during expansion or compression against an external pressure.
concepts.key_idea: Work is the product of external pressure and change in volume.
question_patterns: calculate the work done during expansion
find the work done when gas is compressed
what is the pressure volume work for a given volume change
determine the work done against constant external pressure
compute work if volume changes by a certain amount

solution_steps.explain: find the net change in volume
multiply negative external pressure by volume change

concepts.title: Enthalpy Change Relation
concepts.definition: The relationship between enthalpy change and internal energy change for reactions involving gases.
concepts.key_idea: Enthalpy accounts for internal energy plus pressure-volume work.
question_patterns: calculate enthalpy change from internal energy
find delta_h given delta_u and temperature
determine the change in internal energy for a reaction
how to calculate enthalpy change for gaseous reactions
compute delta_u using enthalpy change

solution_steps.action: calculate product of gas constant and temperature

solution_steps.explain: add internal energy change to the product of moles and rt

concepts.title: Heat Capacity Calculation
concepts.definition: The quantity of heat required to raise the temperature of a given amount of substance by one degree.
concepts.key_idea: Heat absorbed is proportional to mass, specific heat, and temperature rise.
question_patterns: calculate heat required to raise temperature
find the heat absorbed by a substance
determine the energy needed for a temperature change
compute heat using specific heat capacity
how much heat is needed for a specific mass

solution_steps.explain: difference between final and initial temperature
multiply specific heat by mass and temperature change

concepts.title: Gibbs Energy and Spontaneity
concepts.definition: The criterion for spontaneity of a process at constant temperature and pressure.
concepts.key_idea: Negative Gibbs energy change indicates a spontaneous process.
question_patterns: calculate gibbs energy change
determine if a reaction is spontaneous
find delta_g given enthalpy and entropy
predict spontaneity using gibbs equation
compute free energy change

solution_steps.explain: product of temperature and entropy change
subtract entropy term from enthalpy change

worked_examples.question_pattern: calculate work done for expansion of gas against pressure {p} atm with volume change {dv} litres
find delta_u if delta_h is {dh} and delta_ng*rt is {nrt}
